label: Exoplanets
description: Exoplanet papers: one row per planet (per solution when the paper fits a planet more than one way), with the planet's, its host star's and the system's parameters as this paper reports them (and their uncertainties), in the NASA Exoplanet Archive's Planetary Systems column layout. Also records how the values were obtained: models, data, joint fits, software, priors, assumptions. Checked against the archive's parameter set for the same reference.

variable_categories.label: Observations & Data
variable_categories.description: the data behind the results: facilities and instruments, observing campaigns and dates, number of RVs / transits / epochs, time baseline, cadence, exposure times, signal-to-noise

variable_categories.label: Stellar Activity
variable_categories.description: the host star's activity as measured: activity indices (log R'HK, S-index, H-alpha), rotation or spot signals, flares, activity cycles, and whether they correlate with the planet signal

variable_categories.label: Data Reduction and Software
variable_categories.description: how the data were prepared before fitting and the software used: reduction pipelines, outlier removal or sigma clipping, detrending, removing stellar activity (GP, linear decorrelation), jitter terms, binning; software for reduction and modelling
